profile.summaryJa: マナセの死後、その子アモンが王となりました。

facts.textJa: アモンは二十二歳で即位し、二年間エルサレムで治めたと記されます。
アモンの家臣たちは謀反を起こして王を殺しました。
民はアモンに謀反した者たちを殺し、息子ヨシヤを王にしました。
アモンが行った他の事柄はユダの王たちの記録に記されたとされます。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza; and Amon his son reigned in his place.
Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
The servants of Amon conspired against him, and put the king to death in his own house.
But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.
Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
